facts.text: Founded in 1894 by the Colored Methodist Episcopal Church, Texas College is a private Historically Black College that provides liberal arts higher education with an open admission policy.

sources.title: Mission, Core Values, & Vision - Texas College
sources.quote: Texas College is a Historically Black College founded in 1894, by the Colored Methodist Episcopal Church, now the Christian Methodist Episcopal Church (CME).

sources.title: Quick Facts - Texas College
sources.quote: Texas College, one of the Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCU), is a Liberal Arts, coed, private, and faith based institution with open admission.
